title: Locally-Guided Tampa Sightseeing Tour in Street-Legal Golf Cart
includes: Photos at Tampa's most iconic landmarks
Stops at Tampa's most Iconic landmarks
Microphoned Guide so you can easily hear all of our fun facts!
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us for an exciting and informative journey through the vibrant city of Tampa, guided by a Tampa native and University of Tampa Graduate. Your guide will bring you an unmatched depth of knowledge and passion for the city as you explore the city on our brand-new street-legal golf cart. 

Your guide will share Tampa's rich history and the city's plans for the future while stopping along the way for photo opportunities at our most iconic landmarks. We will provide true insider knowledge and leave you with the best-kept secrets of dining, entertainment and exploration, ensuring that your amazing experience in Tampa extends beyond the tour as well.
